name: create-pr
description: Create or update a pull request from a branch.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token with pull request permissions.

REPOSITORY.description: Repository in the format "owner/name". Defaults to the current repository.

HEAD_BRANCH.description: Head branch name for the pull request. If the branch does not exist, it will be created from the base branch.

WORKING_DIRECTORY.description: Working directory where changes to commit are located. Defaults to the repository root.

COMMIT_MESSAGE.description: Commit message for the changes being committed. Defaults to the PR title if not provided.

COMMIT_FILES.description: Comma-separated list of files to commit. Defaults to all changes in the workdir.

BASE_BRANCH.description: Base branch for the pull request. Defaults to the default branch of the repository if not provided.

has-changes.description: Whether there were changes to commit when commit-all is enabled.

head-branch.description: Head branch used for the pull request.

action.description: Action taken by the workflow (created, updated, or skip).
